name: Vigil
install: sudo python3 -m pip install --break-system-packages --ignore-installed -r requirements.lock -r requirements-dev.txt && npm ci --prefix clients/web && npm ci --prefix services/agent
start: bash -lc 'sudo service docker start || true; set -euo pipefail; for i in $(seq 1 60); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; if [ "$i" = 60 ]; then echo "docker daemon did not become ready" >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis bifrost; for i in $(seq 1 60); do if docker exec deeptempo-postgres pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U deeptempo -d deeptempo_soc >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker exec deeptempo-redis redis-cli ping 2>/dev/null | grep -q PONG; then break; fi; if [ "$i" = 60 ]; then echo "postgres/redis did not become ready" >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8080/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; if [ "$i" = 60 ]; then echo "bifrost did not become ready" >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; PSQL="docker exec deeptempo-postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U deeptempo -d postgres"; $PSQL -q -c "DO \$d\$ BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = \$q\$vigil\$q\$) THEN CREATE ROLE vigil LOGIN PASSWORD \$q\$vigil\$q\$; END IF; END \$d\$;"; $PSQL -tAq -c "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = \$q\$vigil_test\$q\$" | grep -q 1 || $PSQL -q -c "CREATE DATABASE vigil_test OWNER vigil"; DB_STRICT_SCHEMA=true python -c "from core.storage.connection import init_database; init_database()"; for f in 19_agent_ledger 31_agent_ledger_hash_chain 20_agent_directives 21_agent_run_leases; do docker exec deeptempo-postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -U deeptempo -d deeptempo_soc -f /db-init/$f.sql >/dev/null; done; docker rm -f vigil-ci-postgres >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker run -d --name vigil-ci-postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=deeptempo_test -e POSTGRES_USER=test -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test -p 127.0.0.1:5433:5432 postgres:16-alpine >/dev/null; for i in $(seq 1 60); do docker exec vigil-ci-postgres pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U test -d deeptempo_test >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; if [ "$i" = 60 ]; then echo "CI test postgres did not become ready" >&2; exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done; printf "%s\n" TESTING=true POSTGRES_HOST=localhost POSTGRES_PORT=5433 POSTGRES_USER=test POSTGRES_PASSWORD=test POSTGRES_DB=deeptempo_test DATABASE_URL=postgresql://test:test@localhost:5433/deeptempo_test > "$HOME/vigil-ci-test.env"; CIPSQL="docker exec -i vigil-ci-postgres psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -U test -d deeptempo_test"; $CIPSQL -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;"; (set -a; . "$HOME/vigil-ci-test.env"; DB_STRICT_SCHEMA=true python -c "from core.storage.connection import init_database; init_database()"); for f in 19_agent_ledger 31_agent_ledger_hash_chain 20_agent_directives 21_agent_run_leases; do $CIPSQL -c "SET client_min_messages = warning" -f - < infra/database/init/$f.sql >/dev/null; done; bash scripts/agent_testdb.sh'
